remarks: Completely renovated and move-in ready, this spacious unit is ideally located in Stamford's desirable Springdale neighborhood. The interior features a fully updated kitchen with new appliances, new flooring and carpeting throughout, and a beautifully updated bathroom with a stall shower. A large living room and generously sized bedroom provide comfortable living space, while an abundance of closets and storage adds everyday convenience. Additional features include free in-building laundry, one assigned driveway parking space, and ample off-street parking. Just minutes from the Springdale train station and within walking distance to local restaurants, shopping, and everyday conveniences, this location truly has it all.
